reviews.text: We have been with the practice for over 20 years and they have looked after all of our 25 dogs from birth to the last closing of their eyes. Their vets are considerate and empathetic and we have no hesitation in offering our pets to their care. The nurses and the admin staff are exceptionally friendly and helpful.

Can’t fault this practice. Staff are very helpful, friendly, professional and accommodating. Had a couple of visits last week (Benny) and both vets were outstanding. Had to call back in a couple of days later due to an eye issue and received practical sound advice from the reception team. Well done, much appreciated.

Heather and the whole team have been absolutely fantastic. Our dog was very poorly and sadly reached the end of her life, but the care, compassion and kindness shown to her throughout was incredible. They kept her calm, comfortable and treated her with so much love and dignity. It was clear that the whole team had grown to love her almost as much as we did.

Even out of hours, they went above and beyond to make sure she was comfortable and that we had the support we needed. We honestly couldn’t have asked for better care during such a difficult time.

I would highly recommend Heather and the entire team to anyone looking for a vet who genuinely cares about both their patients and their owners.

**Edit:** I feel the need to comment on the 1-star review regarding cost, as I think it is incredibly unfair to judge veterinary care purely on the cost of the materials involved.

When you go to the dentist and have a white filling, the material itself only cost a couple of pounds — but you aren’t paying £2 for the filling. You’re paying for years of education, training and expertise, the professional carrying out the procedure, the staff supporting them, the equipment, the premises and all the costs involved in running a safe and professional service.

It’s the same with a plumber: the cost of the pipe is only a tiny part of what you’re actually paying for. You’re paying for their knowledge, experience, time and the business they have invested in to provide that service.

Veterinary practices are no different. You’re paying for highly trained professionals, their expertise, the equipment and facilities, the staff and, most importantly, the care and responsibility involved in looking after someone’s much- loved family member.

Having experienced that care first-hand, I genuinely couldn’t disagree more with that 1-star review. The team went above and beyond for our dog when we needed them most, and they deserve recognition for it.

My pet Labrador Bailey has been treated at Uddingston Veterinary Surgery for 10 years with several problems including having had an eye removed. Right from the ladies on reception to the vets themselves Bailey is treated like he was their own pet. I wouldn't go anywhere else.

I can’t recommend The Veterinary Centre Uddingston enough for the incredible care they give my dog. Chris has looked after Ollie, my French bulldog, over the last few visits and has been absolutely outstanding every time.

What I appreciate most is how personalised each appointment feels, he genuinely tailors everything to Ollie’s needs, rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach.

Chris always puts us as worried owners completely at ease, and I honestly wouldn’t want anyone else looking after my dog. I’m so grateful for the care and attention Ollie has received from Chris. Thank you so much for everything.
